instruction_completeness_test.reasoning: Instruction alone does not reveal platform-child binding, subject walk through the index, or numeric epoch frontier — agent must read code and fixtures.

discovery_budget.discovery: Ledger hop writer must bind each promotion to the platform-manifest content digest selected by the lab arch filter, not the OCI index digest stored in the journal dest field after tag push.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Naming index-vs-platform binding collapses the Rust diagnosis to a one-line digest swap.

discovery_budget.discovery: Auditor subject resolution must walk attestation subjects through the image index to the same platform child the ledger tracks; verifying the index digest alone yields false admit/deny.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Stating the subject-walk rule turns the Go fix into a recited recipe.

discovery_budget.discovery: Policy admit compares against the post-replay renumbered numeric epoch frontier; string equality with pre-replay stage labels admits stale ledger rows.
discovery_budget.why_instruction_must_not_reveal: Revealing numeric-vs-string epoch compare removes the policy-side discovery.

instruction_specificity.reasoning: Brief describes disagreeing admit decisions and healthy surface status without naming causes, algorithms, or fix files.

attack_path.summary: Solver traces a promoted image from journal → ledger row → attestation subject → policy frontier, discovers index/platform mismatch and epoch renumber skew, then patches op_a, fold_b, and phase_c so replay converges.
attack_path.reasoning: Winning path requires reading both language trees and joining three views into one admit set.

smallest_plausible_patch.summary: Change Rust hop binding to platform digest, Go subject walk to that child, and policy epoch compare to numeric frontier — three coordinated edits across languages.
smallest_plausible_patch.reasoning: Any single-location patch leaves at least two tests failing under the flipping-point contract.

collapse_audit.reasoning: After honest symptoms disclosure, residual work is recovering three coupled identity rules from a dual-language codebase with decoys and false-green surface status.
collapse_audit.residual_hardness: Agent must distrust surface status, map index vs platform digests across fixtures, and align epoch frontiers without instruction naming those rules.
